concept: One imagined handover desk becomes a working surface for revising feedback. The opening question has no usable action attached to it; the same note gradually gains an accurate account, a proposed next action and room for discussion. Return to the opening composition with the wording clearer, not the colleague compliant. This is a literal workplace setting, not a metaphor for how people behave. The same situation evolves throughout; local worlds change between the conversation edge, enlarged update, review strip, discussion margin and private writing surface. Refresh the surrounding object field about every 15 to 20 seconds at a narrated change of focus, while retaining the note's layout and object identities. The answer-hidden decision hold is an intentional exception. Hybrid allocation means motion inside a template to construct or expose the rewrite, not extra character acting or fabricated workplace events.
world: A restrained illustrated handover desk on warm paper. The draft, empty client-file outline, update note and date-free review strip are stable landmarks. Two small colleagues occupy opposite edges in neutral designed poses; the woman presenter appears only on allocated avatar beats. The viewer's blank note later occupies the same desk, with the imagined example visibly separate. Nested stations are the conversation edge, update close-up, review strip, open discussion margin and recipient-view writing surface. Captions remain outside the working objects in a stable, legible lane. No crowds, invented office facts, dates, results, exaggerated expressions or assent gestures.
look: story-cartoon, selected classic flat illustration. Round outlined objects, chat bubbles, bare paper panels, underlined labels, restrained duotone props and one crisp cel shade. Use the pack's warm paper and dark ink, with near-off material grain rather than a moving noise overlay. Hand-lettered display accents are limited to short signs; spoken clauses and captions use the legible pack text hierarchy. Small neutral people must come from designed rigs. An asset-backed resting hand may frame a writing surface, but no performed hand or character animation is selected. Missing poses or hand assets fall back to non-figurative desk props, not invented figure drawing. Pack overshoot is reserved for small purposeful arrivals at the opener or payoff, never definitions, evidence boundaries or the quiz. Accent #A9442A means narrated attention throughout, never danger, correctness, agreement or success. Keep clothing and inactive objects neutral; use no other saturated accent family.

devices.what: The same desk and handover objects return at wider shots. Small colleagues use neutral designed poses, with no acted reactions. A resting hand from an approved asset may frame private writing, with desk-edge framing as today's non-figurative fallback. The opening desk is recalled at the close without a successful-performance scene.

D-114 swap slot on the physical feedback note. Replace a person label with an event clause, append an omission and impact, then expose the proposed future-action line. Empty slots are questions, not missing decoration. Slot changes depict the wording being built, never the requested action being performed. Today's fallback is held template elements with a continue join, not custom swap code.

D-114 magnifier enters a detail already visible on the desk note: the person label, omitted input, provenance or reader-facing wording. Keep the parent note and desk edge visible so the detail has a world. Calm object-bound underlines locate the spoken detail. No generic camera zoom or new evidence is introduced.

A chat bubble and unanswered margin preserve room for perspective, feelings, feasibility and mutual clarification. A neutral unease annotation can be replaced by the imagined question; no face performs the emotion. Practical checks point back to behaviour and proposed action. Agreement, ability and execution remain unfilled. Small bubble-anchor pops are allowed only on meaningful arrivals; static bubbles are the fallback.

D-114 data as objects without invented measurements: event wording belongs to the handover note, the omission to the empty file outline, impact to the date-free review strip and proposed action to a missing-input flag. Lists are labelled props attached to these objects or writing fields, not free-floating bullets. D-114 stepped time is used only for the imagined review tile's scheduling change in b02. Later review pairs are static. Stamps label objects but never certify a draft or person.

One join material, paper notes. D-114 handoff transfers attention to another side of the same conversation; D-114 page opens an existing note's discussion or evidence margin. Use the built-in material joins, never hand-coded imitations. Today's fallback is a hard cut for a changed view and continue for the same held layout. Every section boundary remains a hard cut, never a page wipe.

join_material: Paper notes, using built-in handoff and page joins inside a topic. Hard cuts mark chapters; continue holds mechanisms and scaffold structure. A push only enters a detail visibly nested inside the note, never disguises a chapter change.
